name: umm
description: Anchors npm to this repository. The frontend lives in web/, so before this file existed any `npm run ...` at the repository root walked past the checkout and bound to whatever package.json happened to sit in an ancestor directory (a developer's home directory, for example) — `npm test` answered 'Missing script', and a foreign file that did define a script of that name would have run instead. The scripts below are the ones CI runs with working-directory: web, forwarded with the same `npm --prefix web` form the Makefile uses. Having a package.json here also pins the module type for scripts/*.js, which are CommonJS. Deliberately no `version` field: scripts/check-version.sh guards VERSION against web/package.json by explicit path, and a third copy of that number here would be one more place for a release to break.
